resources.string:
As you type a meal's name, the app looks through what you have eaten before and offers it back below the field.

The weight is read straight out of the name: "Tomatoes, 500 g". It understands g, gr, gram, kg, ml and l, and their Russian spellings; kilograms and litres count as a thousand. A number with no unit after it is not a weight, so "Coffee #3" stays just a name.

What a suggestion shows is the weight you wrote down last time and the calories you gave it that same time — always the two from one meal, never a weight from one and a number from another.

Tapping a suggestion fills in both fields. Change the weight inside the name afterwards and the calories follow, in proportion. The moment you type a number into the calorie field yourself it becomes yours, and the app stops touching it until you tap a suggestion again.
